newsitem.title: USA: Corporate Vision gets StatSoft contract.
newsitem.headline: Corporate Vision gets StatSoft contract.

text.p: Corporate Vision Inc said Tuesday it signed an agreement with StatSoft Inc to produce various components of an interactive multimedia CD-ROM to be used by StatSoft for sales and marketing.
Corporate Vision will produce video and 3D animation in addition to other elements of the interactive CD.
The value of the contract was not disclosed.
Corporate Vision is a multimedia company that develops custom CD-ROM applications for companies to use in their training and marketing activities.
